limitations: READ THIS FIRST: retrieval and discovery are UNCHANGED at 47/48 and 30/31, and rules-answer support is newly measured at 1/10. The unchanged card numbers are the absence of an effect, not a validation; the 1/10 is the first measurement of a criterion that previously did not exist, not a regression.

The rules-support labels are PROPOSED, not ratified, and 3 of the 10 (rules-008, rules-009, rules-010) carry verification: proposed_unreviewed because the adversarial panel ran out of session budget before reconciling them. A failure scored against an unratified label is a lead, not a verdict.

Nothing was tuned in response to this number. The rules plans, their queries and their bounds are byte-identical to the run that scored 47/48 with rules support unmeasured. Investigating why a required rule did not come back is the next step and has not been done.

A development measurement against a development bundle, not the G2 gate. Five blockers are registered in fixtures/research/g2_blockers.yaml, four of them open, and every one is a ratification rather than an engineering task.

Not evidence of generalization. Several plans had their bounds chosen after inspecting where the then-labelled answers ranked. deck-local-009 is the demonstration, failing because its fitted bound did not survive the label correction, and it was left failing rather than re-tuned.
16 of the 47 card-retrieval passes are name lookups whose ask prints every required card's name. Discovery over questions that do not name their own answer is 30/31.
metagame-010 left the retrieval denominator: it asks which lands appear most often, and no cohort counts exist to answer a frequency claim until R5. The denominator is 48, not 49.

The absence and clarification gates are declared_not_measured, and the no-finding and counterexample gates are not_measured, because R3 has no narrator. For combo-004 specifically: the counterexample gate semantics are tested, but recommendation behaviour is unmeasured in R3.

Near-miss detection reports not_evaluable for all ten questions. This round's near misses are prose annotations with no quote, so the matcher could not look for them; that is distinct from having looked and found none.
mechanic-013's pass isolates the effect of final-fusion top_k FOR THAT PAIR. The conclusion is local to those two plans and is not a general claim about answer windows.
